title: We could just share
setting: Same restaurant, still waiting. Maya and Chris are getting a little punchy from hunger. Faster, drier, more overlap and reductions — TV-register talk on the same food theme, fully original.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I don't even think I'm that hungry anymore.
lines.spoken: I don't even think I'm that hungry anymore.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm not lying, I just—okay, I could eat, but I don't wanna do a whole thing.
lines.spoken: I'm not lying, I just—okay, I could eat, but I don't wanna do a whole thing.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You know what I mean. We could just share something. Like, one big plate, we both pick at it, we leave.
lines.spoken: You know what I mean. We could just share something. Like, one big plate, we both pick at it, we leave.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You say that, and then you eat two thirds of it, and you look at me like I stole from you.
lines.spoken: You say that, and then you eat two thirds of it, and you look at me like I stole from you.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: It happened at least two times, and you know it.
lines.spoken: It happened at least two times, and you know it.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Fine. We share, I won't be weird about it. You wanna do the nachos? Or is that a terrible idea.
lines.spoken: Fine. We share, I won't be weird about it. You wanna do the nachos? Or is that a terrible idea.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's a terrible idea and also the only idea I have.
lines.spoken: That's a terrible idea and also the only idea I have.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Nachos. And if you go for the last one, I'm gonna say something.
lines.spoken: Nachos. And if you go for the last one, I'm gonna say something.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'll leave you the last one. I'm a generous person.
lines.spoken: I'll leave you the last one. I'm a generous person.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're a person, I'll give you that.
lines.spoken: You're a person, I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Are you actually not hungry, or are you just being annoying?
lines.spoken: Are you actually not hungry, or are you just being annoying?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah, no, I'm hungry. I was trying to be the easy one. It didn't work.
lines.spoken: Yeah, no, I'm hungry. I was trying to be the easy one. It didn't work.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It never works. Just say you want nachos.
lines.spoken: It never works. Just say you want nachos.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I want nachos. Go order before I talk you out of being hungry again.
lines.spoken: I want nachos. Go order before I talk you out of being hungry again.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You weren't talking me out of—okay. Going.
lines.spoken: You weren't talking me out of—okay. Going.

gist.askEn: What are they trying to decide?

gist.askZh: 两个人实际饿不饿？语气是怎样的？
gist.askEn: Are they actually hungry, and what's the tone?

details.askZh: Maya 为什么不太相信‘拼一份’？
details.askEn: Why is Maya suspicious of sharing?
accept: he's been weird about the last one before

details.askZh: 他们最后决定点什么？谁去点？
details.askEn: What do they decide to order, and who goes?

glue.span: I don't wanna do a whole thing
glue.hear: I don't wanna do a whole thing
glue.noteZh: a whole thing 在口语里指‘搞得很隆重、点一堆’，wanna do a 缩在一起。
glue.standard: I don't want to do a whole thing

glue.noteZh: could just share 三个词都很轻，这是建议而不是义务；just 不要听丢。
yeah no 不是前后矛盾：yeah 先接住对方，no 再把意思转过来，真正的信息是 I'm hungry。

chunks.meaningZh: 要不然我们就拼一份吧。
chunks.sayAfter: We could just share something. One big plate, we both pick at it.
I don't even think I'm that hungry anymore.

chunks.meaningZh: 你现在完全是在说谎。（亲近的调侃，不是严肃指责。）
chunks.sayAfter: You're so lying right now. I can tell you're hungry.

roleplay.setupZh: 你们等餐等得有点烦，两个人都饿，但谁也不想再点一整桌。用轻松、带点刺的口气商量拼一份，把‘最后一块归谁’说清楚。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, dry and a little defensive about past sharing incidents. He will pretend not to be hungry, then give in. Keep the teasing, don't turn it into a lecture or a sitcom fight.
variants: Maya is the one who usually eats more.
They share and also keep one small plate each.
The nachos are already sold out.
starters: I don't even think I'm that hungry anymore.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲这段有点贫的对话：谁先说不饿，为什么要拼一份，为什么 Maya 不放心，最后点了什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。可以说得比原对话更直，但要留下那种互相抬杠的味道。
fluency.promptEn: Retell this dry, teasing exchange: who claimed not to be hungry, why they wanted to share, why Maya didn't quite trust it, and what they ordered. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30. You can be more direct than the original, but keep the attitude.
